messages.author: 0b4af18b60604381
messages.subject: Importing data into occumulti UMF
parts:
Hello, 

Maybe this is a simple question, but I've been running in circles. I'm attempting the occumulti analysis in unmarked. When supplying the y data, I'm getting this error:

> umf <- unmarkedFrameOccuMulti(y = ylist2, siteCovs = sitecovs, obsCovs=NULL)
Error in checkSlotAssignment(object, name, value) :
  assignment of an object of class “data.frame” is not valid for slot ‘y’ in an object of class “unmarkedFrame”; is(value, "matrix") is not TRUE

I understand the y data should be as a list, and that is the class of my data. However, I imported each species' detection history individuals, where it is provided in the example code in the AHM book as a dataset. The provided dataset specifies the detection histories as integers, within a list. Mine are as list of data frames within a list. Screenshots of the data classes are included below. 

If someone has suggestions on how to convert the data to read in the UMF properly, I would really appreciate it! 

Thank you so much in advance. 
-Sara

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Importing data into occumulti UMF
parts:
Hi Sara,

The individual elements of the y list should be matrices, not data frames. If you convert each to a matrix with as.matrix() it should work.

Ken
